title: A Thousand Mountains | The Moon Deity
subtitle: A quick writing exercise in Teacher Qingdou’s class
body:
Work again!!! Work again!!! Work again!!!

I hate these vulgar humans

The first to say “The moon is beautiful tonight” was a genius

But after thousands upon thousands of repetitions

I only want to roll my eyes and curse these brainless bastards who do nothing but copy, copy, copy

Tonight’s amusement is cruelty

She loves her, she loves him, he loves him

The heartbreak sound of a rose falling to the ground

Matches Apollo’s silent roar when his ear is pulled off

But I cannot bear the nightingale’s tears

A little bundle, fluffy and wet

Lying so cold beneath the petals

The morning dew glitters in tiny crystal points

I know I should leave, but I do not want to leave

Even if I cannot warm you

At this moment I only want to hold you
